segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ הָעוֹבֵד עֲבוֹדָה זָרָה: אֶחָד הָעוֹבֵד, וְאֶחָד הַמְזַבֵּחַ, וְאֶחָד הַמְקַטֵּר, וְאֶחָד הַמְנַסֵּךְ, וְאֶחָד הַמִּשְׁתַּחֲוֶה, וְאֶחָד הַמְקַבְּלוֹ עָלָיו לֶאֱלוֹהַּ, וְהָאוֹמֵר לוֹ ״אֵלִי אַתָּה״.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «One who worships idols» is executed by stoning. This includes «one who worships» an idol, «and one who slaughters» an animal as an idolatrous offering, «and one who burns» incense as an idolatrous offering, «and one who pours a libation» in idol worship, «and one who bows» to an idol, «and one who» declares that he «accepts» an idol «upon himself as a god, and one who says to» an idol: «You are my god.»

segments.he: אֲבָל הַמְגַפֵּף, וְהַמְנַשֵּׁק, וְהַמְכַבֵּד, וְהַמְרַבֵּץ, וְהַמְרַחֵץ, וְהַסָּךְ, וְהַמַּלְבִּישׁ, וְהַמַּנְעִיל – עוֹבֵר בְּלֹא תַעֲשֶׂה. הַנּוֹדֵר בִּשְׁמוֹ, וְהַמְקַיֵּים בִּשְׁמוֹ – עוֹבֵר בְּלֹא תַעֲשֶׂה.
segments.en: «But» with regard to «one who hugs» an idol, «or one who kisses» it, «or one who cleans» it, «or one who sprays» water before it, «or one who washes» it, «or one who rubs» it with oil, «or one who dresses» it, «or one who puts its shoes on» it, he «transgresses a prohibition» but is not liable to receive capital punishment. With regard to «one who vows in» an idol’s «name and one who affirms» his statement by an oath «in its name,» he «transgresses a prohibition.»

segments.he: הַפּוֹעֵר עַצְמוֹ לְבַעַל פְּעוֹר – זוֹ הִיא עֲבוֹדָתָהּ. הַזּוֹרֵק אֶבֶן לְמַרְקוּלִיס – זוֹ הִיא עֲבוֹדָתָהּ.
segments.en: «One who defecates before» the idol known as «Ba’al-Peor» is liable to receive capital punishment, even though defecating is a degrading act, as «that is its» form of «worship.» Likewise, «one who throws a stone at Mercury» is liable to receive capital punishment, as «that is its» form of «worship.»

moves.summary: the capital forms of idol worship
acts of honor and vows by its name are only a prohibition
worship in its customary manner is liable

positions.claim: worship, slaughter, burning incense, libation, bowing, accepting as a god, or saying 'you are my god' incur stoning
hugging, kissing, cleaning, dressing etc., and vowing or swearing by it, violate a prohibition only
worship in an idol's customary manner (Peor, Mercury) incurs liability even if degrading
